_about: French texts of the band analysis (band_analysis.py) and of the transition sheet (transition_planner.py). Keys are the English texts of the code, values their translation; keep every {placeholder} unchanged. Flags, EQ suggestions, resonance descriptions and transition notes are stored in English and translated from these templates when shown. Units, note names and key names stay as they are; DJ jargon stays English (BPM, LUFS, intro/outro, cue, blend, pre-master, EQ).
